newsitem.title: USA: AT&T wins $582 mln contract from West.
newsitem.headline: AT&T wins $582 mln contract from West.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Thursday it won an exclusive five-year contract worth $582 million from West TeleServices Corp to provide voice telecommunications services.
West TeleServices, based in Omaha, Neb., designs and manages high-volume calling campaigns and provides customer service for various American companies.
Under the new contract, AT&T will provide advanced toll-free-calling features, 900 pay-per-call services and enhanced inbound, outbound and international calling.

AT&T said the agreement allows West to provide its clients with integrated communications solutions, including improved call-handling capabilities, real-time call detail and the ability to create specialized customer reports.
